equations.expression: r_d = integral[z_drag,infinity] c_s(z)/H(z) dz; D_M(z)=c*integral[0,z] dzprime/H(zprime); D_H(z)=c/H(z); D_V(z)=[z*D_M(z)^2*D_H(z)]^(1/3)
equations.locator: DESI Sec.I Eqs.1,4,5; Sec.III.1 D_V definition
equations.definitions: Comoving distances and ruler in Mpc; z dimensionless; c in km/s. r_d is at drag, not r_star at last scattering. BAO constrains distance/ruler ratios.
equations.domain: Flat FLRW distance convention; acoustic ruler needs photon-baryon/thermal closure or an explicitly supplied endpoint.

equations.locator: Reviewer-derived massless/pressureless reduction of DESI Sec.I Eqs.1,6, with the explicit supplied-drag engine convention
equations.definitions: a=1/(1+z), h=H0/100; chosen fractional densities as specified in minimal_test. Baryons/photons are subsets of matter/radiation. No mapping from Planck physical densities or fixed T_CMB/Neff.
equations.domain: Flat GR background, positive matter/radiation/photon components, 0<=Omega_b<=Omega_m and 0<Omega_gamma<=Omega_r; nonnegative Lambda. Supplied synthetic drag endpoint; no recombination/neutrino transition/perturbations.

assumptions: ΛCDM is a declared reference, not an established unique truth or replacement for registered alternative cosmologies.
Freeze exact versions, source hashes, likelihood release identities, object order and data cuts.
Planck marginal posterior values are conditioned anchors; no extra Planck-summary likelihood or invented covariance.
BAO templates/reconstruction, SN standardization/bias corrections and shared calibration condition the supplied data.
simplifications: Permanently massless radiation and pressureless matter; no massive-neutrino thermal transition.
z_drag=1059 is a chosen synthetic endpoint, not the Planck Table2 value 1059.94 and not a predicted drag epoch.
Chosen fractional densities replace a fixed-temperature Planck physical-density mapping; Planck r_drag is contextual only, not an exact target.
Primordial/reionization inputs, SN profiles, anchor calibration and CMB spectra are outside this limited test.
Released BAO compression is used conditionally; matching predicted distances/likelihood does not reproduce the DESI inference pipeline or its posterior.
